binding_inventory.scope: direct whole-file hash records naming paths changed between the revisions; not transitive or line-span

review_resolved: independent review of 3c69304c (PASS; F1-F3 low); all three findings are addressed in 6cce0535 under Decision 0123, which amends Decision 0122 items 3 and 8

components.review_fixes: without the job's phase after a decision the host withdraws a suspension for an applied resumption or cancellation and never arms one (F1: shells/host/src/coding_live_runtime.rs SharedSuspension::settle); a failed control request on a suspended run whose host no longer holds it is shown as released and ends the drive (F2: shells/host/src/cli_runtime.rs ControlOutcome::Released, shells/host/src/coding_client.rs JobControlNotice::Released, shells/host/src/coding_development_client.rs run_released); tests isolate the withheld state, the rebinding decision check and the suspended wait (F3)
components.AMR-05.1: kernel/engine/src/gateway_routing.rs: GatewayRoutingMode (local-only, hybrid), RoutedDataClass, HybridRouteGrant and GrantedHybridRoute with a canonical digest; a remote route is eligible only in hybrid mode under its own grant for the exact route and candidate, before expiry, for every data class sent, within the owner-counted request and input-token budget and, when replacing a failed route, only if the grant allows fallback; the receipt records the mode, data classes, grant digest and provider
components.AMR-05.2: capabilities/knowledge/src/memory_lifecycle.rs (revoke, revoke_source, MemorySourceRevocation, MemorySourceRevocationReceipt), memory.rs (MemoryItemStatus::Revoked), memory_working.rs (a revoked item is never loaded, not even as history), memory_portable.rs (the revoked state survives export and import)
components.AMR-05.3: shells/host/src/capability_package.rs: CapabilityRevocationList sealed and signed in its own domain, verify_capability_revocations with trusted issuer keys and rollback and fork refusal against the last accepted checkpoint, VerifiedCapabilityRevocations::never_accepted, admission refusing revoked packages, manifests and signer keys and binding the list, deactivate_revoked_entries for revoked and unchecked catalog entries
components.AMR-05.4: kernel/engine/src/action_history.rs (new): a hash-chained action history of authorization, effect digest, outcome, reason code and evidence digests; identifiers that are not plain or that the shared secret detector flags are replaced without a digest; expired entries keep only their place; replay refuses tampered, reordered, truncated and foreign chains; a manual export is rescanned and writes nothing
components.AMR-05.5: shells/host/src/diagnostic_export.rs: SupportBundle (doctor report, component versions, evidence digests, automatic_upload false), build_support_bundle and preview_support_bundle through the existing one-use expiring export approval

mutation_checks: run before the source commit with private tooling, each applying one mutation and running the package filter: 33 single mutations; 32 made their expected test fail at once and one (an untrusted revocation issuer accepted) first survived because the test's untrusted case was refused by a key-digest mismatch instead; the test now isolates the trust rule and the rerun mutant fails it. They cover the F1 settlement (2), the withheld state, the released run, the rebinding check, the suspended wait, routing (7), memory revocation (5), extension revocation (7), action history (5) and support bundles (3). These runs are not retained logs
